votes.motion: to approve the Minutes from the December 19, 2019 Planning Commission Meeting
votes.result: A voice vote was made, motion passed 6-0

votes.motion: to approve the Conditional Use Permit to allow the construction and/or operation of an Accessory Dwelling Unit at 6271 South Sunset Links Drive, subject to the following conditions: The project shall comply with all applicable building and fire codes standards. Interconnected smoke detectors and CO sensors shall be provided throughout the house. The property owner shall obtain a building permit for any proposed remodeling or construction on the site

to grant Final Subdivision approval for Phase 2 of the Wynwood Subdivision on property located at 6604, 6628 & 6652 South 700 West subject to the following conditions: 1. The project shall meet Murray City Engineering requirements including the following: a) Meet City subdivision requirements. b) Meet City drainage requirements. On-site detention/retention is required

to forward a recommendation of approval to the City Council for the requested amendment to the zoning designation of the property located at 6271 South 900 East from A-1, Agriculture to R-1-8, Single-Family Low Density Residential
to nominate Scot Woodbury as 2020 Vice-Chair. Mr. Markham seconded the nomination. Mr. Hacker called for a vote. A__ Travis Nay A__ Phil Markham A__ Maren Patterson
